<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Pagină-1" id="vWR3Y8U4rHYtrny4ng1T"> <mxGraphModel dx="2531" dy="958" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": " @startuml UC5_Map
 left to right direction
 skinparam packageStyle rectangle
 skinparam actorStyle awesome

 actor Owner
 actor \"System\n(event hook)\" as System <<system>>
 actor \"OpenStreetMap\" as OSM <<external>>
 actor \"Maps app\n(Google / Apple)\" as MapsApp <<external>>

 rectangle \"DogApp – 5. Map (optional)\" {
 ' --- Browsing ---
 usecase \"View map\" as UC_ViewMap
 usecase \"Filter by place type\" as UC_FilterType
 usecase \"View place details\" as UC_PlaceDetails
 usecase \"View rating & tags\" as UC_Rating
 usecase \"View upcoming events\nat place\" as UC_PlaceEvents
 usecase \"Get directions\" as UC_Directions
 usecase \"Create event here\n(→ 3. Events)\" as UC_CreateEventHere
 usecase \"Report wrong info\" as UC_ReportPlace

 ' --- Reviews ---
 usecase \"Review place\n(after event)\" as UC_Review
 usecase \"Validate review\n(participant, 1-5, once)\" as UC_ValidateReview

 ' --- Generation ---
 usecase \"Import dog parks / vets\n(seed)\" as UC_Import
 usecase \"Create Place from\npublic event\" as UC_GenPlace
 usecase \"Detect duplicate place\n(< 50 m, similar name)\" as UC_Dedup
 usecase \"Publish place\n(≥ 3 public events)\" as UC_Publish
 }

 Owner --> UC_ViewMap
 Owner --> UC_Review

 UC_FilterType ..> UC_ViewMap : <<extend>>
 UC_PlaceDetails ..> UC_ViewMap : <<extend>>
 UC_PlaceDetails ..> UC_Rating : <<include>>
 UC_PlaceEvents ..> UC_PlaceDetails : <<extend>>
 UC_Directions ..> UC_PlaceDetails : <<extend>>
 UC_CreateEventHere ..> UC_PlaceDetails : <<extend>>
 UC_ReportPlace ..> UC_PlaceDetails : <<extend>>
 UC_Directions --> MapsApp

 UC_Review ..> UC_ValidateReview : <<include>>

 OSM --> UC_Import
 System --> UC_GenPlace
 UC_GenPlace ..> UC_Dedup : <<include>>
 UC_GenPlace ..> UC_Publish : <<include>>

 note right of UC_Import
 One-time seed script:
 leisure=dog_park, amenity=veterinary
 around Cluj. source = OSM,
 visible immediately.
 end note

 note right of UC_GenPlace
 Only PUBLIC events.
 source = USER_EVENTS.
 Private playdates never
 create or reveal a Place.
 end note

 note bottom of UC_Directions
 Simple link to Google / Apple
 Maps with lat/lng.
 No routing API needed.
 end note
 @enduml",
 "config": null
